mutation.title: Mutation failure and retry contracts (scratch files only)
mutation.backupPreserved: converged no-op preserves earlier reversal bytes
mutation.unreadableSelection: unreadable root or nested selection cannot wipe or create a mod
mutation.inventoryFailureRetained: unknown inventory preserves the original partial failure
mutation.overwriteEvidence: only completed or possibly partial overwrites are reported
mutation.persistenceFailed: persistence failure is terminal failure, not success
mutation.retrySameFailure: same retry key retains the failed outcome
mutation.draftRemoved: unique draft is cleaned after a failed replacement
mutation.retryReconciles: fresh retry reconciles disk even when memory already matches
mutation.missingNotSuccess: missing file entry cannot report persistence success
mutation.copyFailureReported: partial copy reports failure and partial effects
mutation.partialRefreshed: partial copy still requests native reconciliation
mutation.partialEvidence: partial effects remain visible in the result
mutation.selectionBeforeWrites: all selected folders are validated before target changes
mutation.dequeueRechecks: busy is checked again when the queued mutation executes
